findings.text: follow-on: every disagreement in the list lists id, name, description, stored role and hand role but gives no "one line why", which the done-when names as part of each listed disagreement, so the reader must infer the reason the two readings differ.

follow-on: the done-when's clause "shows census_signal_roles for jt-60sa reading 210 missing afterwards" is not satisfied — census_signal_roles reports missing 0 in both arms because this tree's shared predicate is status IN ['enriched','checked'], and the 225 figure is an extended-predicate count from census_after.py, not from census_signal_roles; the node states this plainly but the named measure is unmet and its figure 210 is stale against the live 225.

follow-on: the 26-of-30 agreement cannot be re-derived from repository state — the comparison ran from an uncommitted /tmp/ssfms-blind/compare.py and the stored signal_role values it compared against were then set to null on all 225 signals, so the only surviving evidence is measure.log and the table, and a later reader can neither reproduce nor falsify the number.
